## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.11 — Polish pass on the redesigned Lights screen

> **Alpha.** Six fixes from using the redesign on real devices: the room bulk
> tile stops competing with the lamps, the presets strip stays inside the
> layout, the all-lights tile gets breathing room, lamps show their actual
> type, hover no longer wipes a light's color off its card, and brightness
> sliders fill with the light's own color.

### The room bulk tile is borderless and inert

"All in this room" no longer draws a bright border and no longer lifts on
hover — it reads as a summary row inside its room card instead of stealing
focus from the lamps below it.

### Presets strip stays inside the layout

The entertainment-zone scenes strip no longer bleeds past the main container's
right edge; it scrolls horizontally within the page width.

### All-lights tile gets top and bottom spacing

The global tile no longer hugs the first room card, and its gap from the
filter dropdown now matches its gap to the rooms.

### Lamps show their real type

Light cards now use the light's own CLIP v2 archetype for their icon: ceiling
and pendant lamps, floor and table lamps, lightstrips and play bars, the Iris
and Go globes, wall lamps, and spots all get distinct shapes; unknown types
fall back to the bulb.

### Hover keeps the light's border color

The card's 6px color strip no longer turns grey while the card is hovered —
the light's color stays visible during the raise.

### Brightness sliders fill with the light's color

The slider track now paints its filled portion with the light's current color
(live while dragging), instead of sitting as a dark bar.
